name: obsidian-framework
description: Obsidian Framework: AIF methodology on top of an Obsidian vault

scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build -w @of/plugin && npm run bundle:worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/worker && tsc -p packages/plugin
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run coverage
